test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Pandemics have often been caused by a disease that __spreads by physical touch or contact.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **are contagious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contagious"** means a disease that can be spread from one person or organism to another, typically through direct contact. (संक्रामक)
 
 
• **Example:** The flu is a highly contagious illness that affects millions of people each year.
 
 
 
• **"Vigorous"** refers to something strong, healthy, and full of energy. (जोशीला)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a vigorous speech that inspired everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Robust"** means strong and healthy; vigorous. (मजबूत)
 
 
• **Example:** The company has a robust business model that has weathered many economic downturns.
 
 
 
• **"Fastidious"** refers to being very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail. (सूक्ष्म)
 
 
• **Example:** He is fastidious about keeping his room clean and organized.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **are contagious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vigorous **(जोशीला): Strong, healthy, and full of energy.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a vigorous speech that inspired everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **Robust **(मजबूत ): Strong and healthy; vigorous.
 
 
• **Example:** The company has a robust business model that has weathered many economic downturns.
 
 
 
• **Fastidious** (सूक्ष्म): Very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail.
 
 
• **Example:** He is fastidious about keeping his room clean and organized.
